verdicts.reason: Both share the same layout and the same faults. 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' sits alone at the top, far from 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO' at the bottom, so the kicker and headline no longer read as one unit. The confetti is shrunk into a tiny strip under the kicker instead of scattered across the canvas, and big empty bands sit above and below the owls. B has slightly larger owls and its headline sits a little higher, but its brown owl's ear runs into the right edge, so neither is clearly better.
